import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Load the dataset
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', names=column_names, header=None, skiprows=1, sep='\t')

# Calculate the proportion of gardening-introduced plants
invaded_niche['prop_gard'] = invaded_niche['n.gard'] / invaded_niche['n.total']

# Drop rows with missing values
invaded_niche.dropna(inplace=True)

# Define the formula for the regression model
formula = 'prop_gard ~ cropland.1956.50m + urban.1956.50m + cropland.1993.50m + urban.1993.50m + cropland.2009.50m + urban.2009.50m + habitat + elevation + annual.temperature + annual.rainfall + annual.radiation'

# Fit the regression model
model = ols(formula, data=invaded_niche).fit()

# Print the summary of the regression model
model.summary()
